samples.label: Strong prediction: near-perfect HC
samples.reason: Excellent overlap and near-perfect HC measurement; best success-path example.

samples.label: Strong prediction: consistent geometry
samples.reason: Second strong example with high Dice and very low HC error on a different HC size.

samples.reason: Absolute HC error is effectively at the test-set median, making it useful for a non-cherry-picked walkthrough.

samples.label: Cleanup and ellipse teaching case
samples.reason: Shows why post-processing and geometry choices matter: raw contour error is high, cleaned contour improves, and ellipse HC differs.

samples.reason: Largest absolute HC error in the selected run and high HD95; useful for honest model limitation discussion.

samples.label: Failure case: low Dice small HC
samples.reason: Low segmentation quality and large HC overestimate; useful for showing where the pipeline can break down.
